Luitenant_Gruber praises exploratory freedom, character abilities, mouse-drawn attacks, scenery, and music, framing the game as a childhood favorite that remains enjoyable. The review provides a detailed positive counterpoint to retrospectives frustrated by the same combat controls.

Gunkaloo records money of 14,840, a score of 100,330, seventy-one percent spared lives, and a displayed game length of 27:09. These are one player’s self-reported statistics, not verified score calculations or a representative completion time. The site’s separate playtime estimate is based on only one logged playthrough.
